COURT’S OR JUDGE’S ORDERS
D/27 WPMS No.950 of 2025
Hon’ble Ravindra Maithani, J.
 Mr. S.K. Jain, Senior Advocate assisted 
by Mr. Balvinder Singh, Advocate for the 
petitioner.
 Mr. Suyash Pant, Standing Counsel for 
the State/respondent nos.1 and 2.
 Defects ignored.
 Learned counsel for the petitioner 
would submit that the SIT has passed an 
order to transfer the land, etc. of the land 
pertains to the petitioner. He would 
submit that it is wrongly concluded by the 
SIT that the land, which was not 
undertaken in the ceiling proceedings 
were concealed by the petitioner. He would 
submit that the land could not be 
included in the ceiling proceedings 
because it is a non-ZA land, in which, the 
provisions of the Urban Land (Ceiling and 
Regulation) Act, 1976 does not apply.
 There is another question with regard 
to it, as to how SIT could pass such an 
order? What is the authority of SIT? When 
requested, learned State counsel seeks 
time to get instructions in the matter. 
 List on 15.05.2025, just after fresh 
cases. 
 
(Ravindra Maithani, J.)
 06.05.2025
Sanjay

1D WPMS No. 950 of 2025
Hon’ble Ravindra Maithani, J.
Mr. S.K. Jain, Senior Advocate, assisted 
by Mr. Siddharth Jain, Advocate for the 
petitioner.
Mr. Ganesh Kandpal, D.A.G. for the 
State/respondent nos. 1 and 2.
Heard.
Admit. 
Learned C.S.C. takes notice on behalf of 
the respondent nos. 1 and 2.
Issue notice to the respondent nos. 3 
and 4 returnable within six week.
List on 14.07.2025.
Till the next date of listing, status quo, 
qua the land in question, shall be maintained, 
however, it is made clear that petitioner shall 
neither create any third party interest over the 
land in question nor change nature of the 
land, in the meantime.
Interim Relief Application No. 1 of 2025 
stands disposed of accordingly.
